# Open Hangar

> Open Hangar is a free browser extension that reads your Star Citizen hangar from RSI, privately in your own browser. Every pledge, ship and buy-back shows up on openhangar.space, with or without an account.

Open Hangar is an unofficial Star Citizen fan project made by Draco Foundry. It works in Chrome, Edge and Firefox.

## Pages

- [Home](https://openhangar.space/): what Open Hangar is
- [The Extension](https://openhangar.space/extension): what it does, and the Chrome, Edge and Firefox store listings
- [The Store](https://openhangar.space/store): Star Citizen store prices, deals and what's new
- [News](https://openhangar.space/news): Star Citizen news summaries that link to the source
- [Troubleshooting](https://openhangar.space/help.html): fixes for common problems
- [Privacy Policy](https://openhangar.space/privacy.html): what is read, what is kept and what is never sent
